description: TidelFlow 1.0.3 - Maximum Bugs Solved: In-App Installer Engine, 302 Redirect Fix, File Recovery & TidelFlow Branding

changelog.title: Critical In-App Installer Fixes
items: Fixed Install button failure: Resolved issue where GitHub release cross-host 302 redirects aborted downloads prematurely, ensuring the full 70MB APK is completely downloaded.
Automatic file discovery & recovery: The updater now actively detects pre-existing or completed APKs on disk, preventing empty state resets when tapping Install.
Bulletproof installation launch: Explicitly grants URI read permissions to system package installer packages and applies FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP and EXTRA_NOT_UNKNOWN_SOURCE.
Smart retry on missing files: Tapping Install if a file is missing or corrupted automatically initiates a clean re-download instead of failing silently.
Complete TidelFlow branding: Fully updated updater titles, headers, and localized strings to 'TidelFlow' across all screens and notifications.

changelog.title: Permissions & FileProvider Architecture
items: Enabled REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES permission on Android 8.0+ through Android 16.
Consolidated FileProvider authorities (TidelFlow.FileProvider & fileprovider) into a unified provider, eliminating IllegalArgumentException errors.

changelog.title: AI Playlist Engine & Performance
items: Seamless full playlist queueing with continuous YouTube Radio auto-playback.
Intelligent non-repetition memory with dedicated persistent storage.
Ultra-fast AI generation powered by NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B.
Completely non-blocking background YouTube Music synchronization.
